angle: demand side and labour side: OEM supplier/vendor awards and M&A news, dealer allied-line attachment brands, job-posting searches by product and trade (aggregator snippets + OEM career-site search pages), and 2023-2026 plant opening/expansion/acquisition news; each lead resolved to a physical US plant via company/careers/news pages
searches_until_dry: Not cleanly reached. The last 8 consecutive generic searches (67-74) added no new verified in-definition plant, but they left 3 unresolved leads (an unnamed Missouri heavy-equipment weldment maker, an unnamed excavator/loader bucket fabricator on SimplyHired, a Terex mobile-screening welder posting with no site), and name-seeded searches plus page fetches were still adding about one plant per search. Stopped by choice at 74 searches to conserve the shared budget; no search was refused.
notes:
Blind audit: no file under ledger/ was opened except to write this report; tools/AGENT_BRIEF.md not read. Disclosure: an early 'ls' of the shared scratchpad directory exposed other sessions' filenames (some keyed by OEM plant city, e.g. kom_<city>.json, cat_city_<city>.json, mining_top40.json); no contents were read, and this audit worked only in its own subfolder auditR2B. The first command also created searchlog.md in the shared scratchpad root (possibly overwriting a same-named file from another session) and then moved it into auditR2B.
Search counting: 74 WebSearch calls. 39 were name-seeded (query named companies/plants, mostly to resolve or verify leads; these measure recall and never run dry) and 35 were generic (product/trade/OEM-relationship/news queries without company names). Dry point: the last 8 consecutive generic searches (67-74) added no new verified in-definition plant (results were dealers, quarry maintenance jobs, repair shops, non-US firms). But name-seeded queries and free page fetches were still adding about one plant per search (49-66), so the list is NOT exhaustive; stopped by choice at 74 searches to conserve the shared search budget (no search was refused), not because the method was exhausted.
Supplier-award angle (searches 1,2,12,43) yielded almost nothing: Caterpillar/Deere/Komatsu/Volvo award lists are dominated by component, logistics and steel-service suppliers; only D&S Mfg (Deere 2019) and G&D Integrated (Komatsu 2016) came from it.
Quotes: quote_verified=true only where tools/fetch_page.py --check exited 0 on the fetched page. Rows with quote_verified=false either had a blank quote (page blocked/expired; city or product only from a search summary) or a dynamic page. Caterpillar Victoria and Decatur, Sandvik Brier Hill and Rockland Seguin rest on search-summary evidence only.
Products marked 'not stated on source page' (Bobcat Bismarck, Gwinner, Statesville; Cat East Peoria; Komatsu Homer City, Franklin; Sandvik Brier Hill) are in-definition on the strength of being welding production sites of in-definition OEMs; their product line is unverified.
Marked out (in_definition=false): Astec Power Flame (burners), Prime Conveyor (unit-handling conveyors), W.S. Tyler Mentor (wire cloth), Bobcat Johnson Creek WI (product unknown), Caterpillar Houston PA (2016 close/sell review, no current evidence), Hensley Mansfield TX (only 2010 source), CNH Burlington IA (closed Q2 2026), Komatsu Elko NV and Virginia MN (service/rebuild).
Boundary rows kept in-definition and noted: wood/organics grinders (Peterson, Morbark, Bandit x2, Rotochopper); compact/skid-steer attachment makers (Lowe, Danuser, Virnig x2); Ditch Witch (underground construction).
Open leads not resolved to a verified plant (not in plants list): Terex welder postings at Durand MI, Fort Payne AL, Waukesha WI (product lines unknown; jobs.terex.com redirects); Astec-labelled welder postings at Poca WV and Tazewell VA (employer/product unresolved; Monster 403); FLSmidth Winfield WV welder postings; CMI Roadbuilding Oklahoma City (only an office suite address found); Komatsu Mesa AZ and Weir ESCO Phoenix AZ (bucket/dipper fabrication mixed with repair at service sites); Caterpillar Wamego KS (summary attributed posting to Solar Turbines; kansasworks 401); Caterpillar Clayton NC, Sanford NC (compact track loaders per search summary), Athens GA, Waco TX, Denison TX not surfaced or not resolvable via Cat careers (Cloudflare); CNH Fargo ND and Wichita KS (welder postings seen only in search summaries); Kubota Industrial Equipment Jefferson GA (tractor implements, judged out); Delta-Veyor Ossineke MI (site blocked); Automated Conveyor Systems West Memphis AR (bulk vs unit conveyors unclear); Heyl & Patterson and Continental Conveyor (no US plant evidence fetched); IFH Group and Metal Tanks (hydraulic/fuel tanks; location unresolved); New Standard, Laser Precision, Quality Metal Products (Cat award winners, not checked); Ken Garner Mfg, Frontier-Kemper, Fathom, Prime Attachments (unresolved); Kobelco Spartanburg SC and Vermeer Pella IA not resolved.
Method blind spots: (1) small private fabricators and Tier-2 weldment shops that post jobs only on local boards or not at all; (2) OEM career sites behind Cloudflare/JS (Caterpillar, Komatsu, Terex, CNH) - SuccessFactors search pages worked for Deere, Bobcat and Epiroc only, so Cat/Komatsu/Terex/CNH plant coverage is partial; (3) search-engine summaries misattribute employers (e.g. Stafford TX posting was Emerson) and many aggregator pages are 403/410/expired, so many leads cannot be quoted; (4) supplier-award programs name few fabricators; (5) plants with no 2023-2026 news and no indexed welder posting are invisible; (6) generic job searches are swamped by dealer, quarry-maintenance and repair jobs; (7) name-seeded queries drew on the auditor's own knowledge of brands, which biases toward well-known OEMs.
Product fields: for Deere Davenport/Dubuque, several Astec brand rows (contact-page quotes give address only), Komatsu Peoria and others, the quoted text places the plant but the products column comes from other fetched text or search summaries, not from the quote itself.
Astec now owns TerraSource (Gundlach Belleville IL, Jeffrey Rader, Pennsylvania Crusher) per its 2025 10-K; Jeffrey Rader and Pennsylvania Crusher plant sites were not resolved by this method (Woodruff SC / PA sites not confirmed). The Poca WV and Tazewell VA Astec-labelled welder postings may be TerraSource sites; unconfirmed.
G&D Integrated (Morton IL) marked out for stale evidence; Cat South Milwaukee quote came from a related-jobs widget on a 404 page.
